scientific_integrity: Complete self-contained analytic proof and an optional exact rational finite-case checker. The checker is not used as an infinite proof. Novelty is the intermediate face-rank classification, not the earlier dense-orbit observation. Independent audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only finite-dimensional real polyhedral Banach spaces; no complex or nonpolyhedral extension and no bound on the inverse norm. Equivalent claims in nonindexed semigroup literature cannot be excluded; one relevant 2019 paper was inspected by abstract only.
title: Face dimension determines all contraction orbits of finite-dimensional real polyhedral Banach spaces
